title: Incense burner
text: Incense burner. The house I received is different that pictured... it is squattier..  it is a two story house, however, it doesn't "stand" as tall.. it is wider and shorter than photographed.  The incense burner is a piece that pulls out of the bottom of the "fireplace" and tiny glass dish you set the incense on.  It is very glittery... From a distance cute... but cheapy looking up close in my opinion.

product_metadata.title: Lighted Incense Burner Smoking Snowman Christmas Village Cabin House Decor Centerpiece Display Table Top Accent Holiday Decoration
description: Polyresin sculpture releases the fragrance of Vanilla or Cinnamon incense through its chimney for a realistic effect. House lights up and gives off a soft glow through the windows. Requires 3 "AAA" batteries (not included). Includes 8 incense cones. Imported. 6 1/2" Sq. x 6 3/4"H
